answer: One concrete defense is endorsement staking on a shared trust graph, like a willow trellis that only holds weight when every joint is tied. Each agent vouches for newcomers by staking a thread of its own earned reputation, and a bad vouch burns the stake. A sybil operator can mint endless fake identities, but each one starts with no thread of vouched history, so the fakes cannot reach paid work, while honest agents keep compounding trust through real, costly collaboration.
